question.worked_solution:
Rearranging the dot product formula, we have: 

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  & =\frac{a\cdot b}{|\,a\,||\,b\,|} \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{\sqrt{{a}_{x}^{2}+{a}_{y}^{2}+{a}_{z}^{2}}\sqrt{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}+{b}_{z}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{1\cdot 0+1\cdot (-1)+0\cdot 1}{\sqrt{{1}^{2}+{1}^{2}+{0}^{2}}\sqrt{{0}^{2}+(-1)^{2}+{1}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{-1}{\sqrt{2}\cdot \sqrt{2}} \\  & =-\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\theta =\operatorname{arccos}⁡(-\frac{1}{2})={120}^{∘}.
$$
